protocol: Task 6 six-gate closure evidence (toon-look-toggle phase1). Primary instruments per artifacts/toon-audit/README.md pointer table. Same-session paired byte protocol per Task 1 ruling 2026-11-13 (control + variant twins captured back-to-back in ONE capture run, compared in-run). PNG evidence committed under matrix/; this file + region-profile.json + band-profile.json + repro-gate6.json are the committed summaries.

environment.chromeLaunchContract: MUST launch with --disable-features=CalculateNativeWinOcclusion on this desktop: a window born into Chrome's native occlusion tracker gets stuck visibilityState 'hidden' forever (foreground/topmost/restore/move do not clear it), rAF never fires, the capture PRESENT round hangs and captureScreenshot returns ~28KB blank frames. With the tracker disabled the window reads visible and rAF fires instantly. Recipe: task6-scratch/launch-chrome2.ps1

task3ThresholdCheck.criteria: changedInRatio>=0.9 && gradDenseToon1>=3xControl && bestStepJump>=15 (pinned by Task 3 on the PRE-Task-4 composite)
task3ThresholdCheck.result: night PASS; ref-level FAIL (2.3x, jump 14.4); horizon-low FAIL (2.4x) — recorded as FAIL per the pinned criteria
task3ThresholdCheck.interpretation: Task 4's applyToonLook palette layer changed the dome cloud's input colors; on the final composite the dome tier gradients halve vs the Task-3-era calibration. The thresholds are stale, not the feature: control medians bit-identical, night (least palette-affected) still passes at 8.8x. Recalibration belongs to the plan-level capture-calibration flow; recorded, not silently re-picked

cloud.visualCheck: toon1 ref-level: flat banded sky, purple dome cloud with lit/shadow facet separation and hard silhouette; night: deep-purple silhouette with rim/core two-tone, no dead-black mush; deck/patch ring follows the hardened palette (Task 4 expected whole-look semantics, not a regression)

seam.instrument: analyze_horizon_isolation.py caliber discipline: HUD-hidden pair (capture-toon-matrix seam variants, .porco-hud display:none), explicit render flush (present round), isolation band with the waterline detected as the low-variance row with the max upward 2-row step whose sky side is a >=18-row smooth run (pure variance-min and plain max-step both mislocked on earlier attempts — see analyze-task6-regions.mjs header; p15 gates record horizon_row 293-300 for this pose, corroborated at 300), SAME pinned row for both frames, control frame judged with the same instrument
